category: cheap-egress VPS: KVM VPS with a configurable bandwidth allowance

free_tier.stated: No free tier. The Linux KVM VPS is configurable from 1 to 8 vCPU, 1 to 32 GB RAM, 20 to 500 GB storage and 1 to 20 TB bandwidth, from EUR 1.56/mo on a 3-year plan.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a VPS, not an object store

egress.terms: bandwidth is chosen from 1 TB to 20 TB per VPS; the port speed, the overage action and the byte tolerance are not published on the page read.
egress.free_allowance: 1 TB to 20 TB as configured, period not stated

interface_detail: Root KVM VPS with its own kernel.
chaining: The page says to open any port and run any service and lists Docker and WireGuard on the full KVM virtualization, so a UDP WireGuard endpoint is stated to run; per-port and per-protocol limits are not published on the page read.

limits.value: 1 TB to 20 TB of bandwidth chosen per VPS; overage action not published

binding_note: The bandwidth is chosen as a slider from 1 TB to 20 TB, so the countable limit is the chosen allowance, and its overage action is not published.

identity_cost.detail: The signup form asks for first name, last name, email, password, country and phone, plus billing currency and agreement to the terms; no credit card is required to browse, and the terms accept credit and debit cards, PayPal, cryptocurrency, Alipay and bank transfer for payment.

reliability_note: The terms charge a 10% late fee on payments late by more than two days.
confidence_note: Configurator page, signup form and terms read on 2026-11-04. The serverdeals listing MicroKVM (EUR 9.50 a year, 768 MB, 1 TB, 1Gbps) was not found on the vendor pages read.
